_meta.theory: KnowledgeOS Theory v1.2 (weakened v1.1) + class-indexed three-valued Sat

state.test: is Zero stored in K, or computed from it?
state.result: COMPUTED — Zero is a function of (K, Req); no K carries it

relation.result: Zero(K, Req) is a PREDICATE over one state plus a contract; it relates K to a requirement SET, not to another K
relation.verdict: PARTIAL — it is contract-relative, not state-to-state

predicate.claim: Zero is a predicate on K
predicate.test: does it return a truth value?
predicate.result: two-valued under readings strict/weak; THREE-valued under Kleene (U)
predicate.verdict: SUPPORTED — but its arity is 2 (K, Req) and its VALUE SET is contested: {T,F} or {T,F,U}

boundary.result: only under three-valued Sat: U marks absence, F marks negation. Under two-valued Sat the boundary COLLAPSES

derived_view.claim: Zero is a projection of K
derived_view.test: is it recomputable from K and Req alone?

missingness.test: does Zero distinguish the four unknown kinds?
missingness.result: NO — UNOBSERVED / UNINTERPRETED / UNDERDETERMINED / UNOBSERVABLE all map to U. Zero cannot tell them apart
missingness.verdict: REFUTED — Zero is coarser than the missingness taxonomy

metaphor.claim: Zero is merely a conceptual metaphor
metaphor.test: does removing it change any computed outcome?
metaphor.result: no outcome depends on the NAME; every outcome depends on GapPartition. Zero adds a label, not a computation
metaphor.verdict: NOT REFUTED — Zero may be a NAME for a derived view
